text:
maya (People Ops): Heads-up 00 candidate for Embedded Systems Engineer requests three accommodations: severe nut allergy (no cross-contact), asks for ASL interpreter for portions of the loop, and needs escorted access to the secure lab (on-site hardware testbed) with pre-approved biosafety checklist. cc @tom @nina

Tom (Recruiter): Thanks Maya. Candidate arrives 8/12 afternoon, prefers morning interviews starting 9:30. Lab access requires background clearance and a short onboarding. Security, can we expedite for a same-week badge?

ops-security-bot: Security note: secure lab access (Level 2 clearance) needs SSO + background cleared. Typical lead time 3 business days. We can run an expedited check if candidate provides two forms of government ID and signs the lab NDA. Please submit via secure form: https://internal.redwood/sec/visitor-expedite?ref=2187654321

nina (Hiring Manager): We rely on the hardware bench for a 45m pairing task. If badge isn't ready, can ops provision a supervised bench session with an in-room escort and no network access? Also we need ASL for the behavioral loop (~30m). What are costs for interpreter?

accessibility-bot: ASL interpreter booking: we use vendor "SignBridge". Typical cost: $180/hour + travel. We can approve up to $250 total for the session under code "access-2187". Please provide exact times so we can confirm. In-person or remote interpreter both available; candidate prefers in-person.

catering-bot: Noted nut allergy. We'll order individually labeled boxed lunches from allergen-safe caterer. No tree-nut or peanut anywhere in prep area; cross-contact protocol will be included. Expense code: "cand-food-2187".

maya (People Ops): Action plan proposal: 1) Start 9:30 in Reception for welcome + ASL interpreter present 9:30-10:15 for intro and behavioral panel. 2) 10:30-11:15 supervised hardware bench in secure lab with escort if badge not ready. 3) 11:30-1:00 technical pairing (non-lab) and lunch in allergen-safe boxed meals. 4) Contingency remote pairing slot 3pm if bench access denied. I'll mark calendar with allergy note and escort arrival point.

Tom (Recruiter): Candidate can supply two ID forms today and sign NDA. I'll send secure upload link now. Also candidate asked about sign-language-friendly interview materials (slides with captions). Nina, can interviewers prepare slides and speak clearly for ASL support?

nina (Hiring Manager): Yes, we'll provide slide deck and write up of tasks in advance. Interviewers will avoid rapid overlapping talk and will use a single microphone. Also request that technical whiteboarding be photographed and transcribed.

ops-security-bot: Received IDs via secure form. NDA pending signature. Expedited vetting initiated (target badge ready in 48 hours). Lab escort confirmed if badge not done.

accessibility-bot: ASL booked in-person 9:20-10:20 (SignBridge). Confirmation email sent to candidate. Budget flagged under access-2187.

maya (People Ops): Catering ordered  boxed lunches labeled "nut-free" and separate prep chain. Also reserving Quiet Room B for candidate decompression 12:45-1:15. Parking: reserved accessible spot near loading bay; rideshare after 7pm covered up to $70 (code "cand-2187").

Tom (Recruiter): Candidate confirmed they prefer in-person interpreter, appreciates Quiet Room, and will sign NDA now. I've updated calendar invites with lab escort details and allergen note.

nina (Hiring Manager): Thanks team. One more: please ensure bench supervisor disables external network on testbench and we have a standardized bench image ready. IT ticket?

op-support-bot (automated): IT ticket IT-9005 created for bench image & network lockdown. ETA 24 hours.

maya (People Ops): Closing: ASL booked, expedited security in progress, supervised bench fallback confirmed, nut-safe catering ordered, Quiet Room reserved. If badge clears early we'll swap escorted bench for standard lab. Ping me for any last-minute changes. :white_check_mark:
